Allergy documentation is a core medication-safety element and omissions here carry meaningful risk.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the intended twice-daily dosing for topical steroid can lead to underuse (reduced efficacy/prolonged symptoms) or overuse (increased risk of local adverse effects such as skin thinning), depending on how the patient interprets instructions. In most workflows the prescription label often provides dosing, limiting harm, but the omission still risks confusion.
